title: Research exploring customer views on revenue correction notices
text: The research aimed to understand how HM Revenue and Customs ( HMRC ) can support customers to provide an explanation where they choose to reject revenue corrections. It also tested improvements to revenue correction notices, including HMRC providing a more detailed explanation for the correction. The research was conducted in November and December 2025 and consisted of 18 qualitative interviews with customers.

attachments.title: Research to explore customer perceptions of potential changes to revenue correction notices
